errors.text_span: Die rechte y-Achse, mit dem Titel „Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat“ und „Schuldenquote Zentralstaat“
errors.evidence: The right y-axis is a single debt-ratio axis; its label is not two separate titles. The chart uses 'Schuldenquote Zentralstaat' on the right-hand panel, while the left panel's right axis corresponds to 'Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat'.

The description does not mention that each panel contains an unlabeled triangle-marker series in addition to the colored lines, nor does it clearly distinguish these marker-only series as separate visual elements.
